title: Piccolo: Keyboard window management for macOS
description: Piccolo tiles the windows you just used, resizes them together and swaps them around, all from the keyboard. US$4.99, one-time purchase, with a 14-day free trial.
lead_1: Piccolo tiles the windows you just used
lead_2: and keeps your desktop tidy, all from the keyboard.
hero_trial: Free for 14 days, no credit card needed
demo_label: A Mac desktop with three overlapping windows. Holding Control-Option-4 shows where they will go; on release they tile in a 2 by 2 grid. Control-Option-equals moves the divider right twice and all three windows resize together. Control-Option-Right Arrow swaps the focused window with its neighbour.
f1_title: Tile the windows you’re actually using
f1_text: Piccolo remembers which windows you used last. One shortcut lays out the latest two, three or six side by side or in a grid on the current display, so you never pick them one by one.
f1_label: Control-Option-2 puts the two most recent windows side by side, Control-Option-3 the three most recent in columns, and Control-Option-6 six windows in a 2 by 3 grid.
f2_text: Once Piccolo has arranged a group, a shortcut moves the divider next to the focused window and its neighbours follow, with no gaps and no overlaps. Swap Window trades two windows’ places and the layout stays.
f2_label: Three windows in columns. Control-Option-equals widens the middle window twice while the right one shrinks, Control-Option-minus widens it to the left twice, and Control-Option-Right Arrow swaps it with the right window.
f3_title: See where it goes before it moves
f3_text: Hold a shortcut and a highlight shows the destination. Let go to move the window there, or press Esc and nothing changes.
f3_label: Holding Control-Option-H highlights the left half; Escape cancels and the window stays. Holding Control-Option-L highlights the right half, and on release the window moves there.
lay_center_text: Same size, right in the middle
lay_custom_text: Draw your own on the screen
lay_restore_text: Back to where it was before
rebind_title: Every shortcut is yours to change
rebind_text: Click an action in Settings and press the keys you want. Grids and custom areas get their own shortcuts too, and power users can edit the config file by hand.
craft_img_alt: Settings window, Shortcuts tab: a search field and a keymap in grouped cards, Halves, Quarters, Thirds and Other, each row with a small picture of the frame, the action’s name and its shortcut, such as ⌃⌥H for Left Half.
craft_keymap_text: Every action in one list. Click a row, press the keys, and it’s saved. ⌘Z undoes any change.
craft_motion_text: Windows glide into place and bounce softly when there’s nowhere to go. Pick the speed, or turn it off.
craft_fill_text: When the windows don’t fill a grid, choose whether the last one stretches down or across: columns first for a wide display, rows first for a portrait one.
craft_gap_text: Leave a gap between windows and around the edges, so shadows don’t pile up into dark seams.
craft_lang_text: English, 简体中文, 繁體中文, 日本語, Français, Español, Português and Deutsch.
craft_private_text: No account, no analytics. Only the license check and the update check go online.
price_1: One license for up to 3 Macs
price_fine: Orders are processed by Dodo Payments, the merchant of record, which handles payment, tax and invoices.
faq_need_text: macOS 14 or later, and the Accessibility permission: Piccolo moves other apps’ windows through the macOS Accessibility API, so without it no window moves.
faq_ax_text: Piccolo moves and resizes other apps’ windows through the macOS Accessibility API, and without the permission no window moves. It uses it to read and change the position and size of windows. You grant it under System Settings, Privacy & Security, Accessibility.
faq_data_1: License activation sends your license key and your Mac’s model identifier (for example MacBookPro18,3) to Dodo Payments.
faq_data_2: License validation sends the key and the activation ID to Dodo Payments about once a week.
faq_data_3: Deactivate This Mac sends the key and the activation ID to Dodo Payments.
faq_data_4: The update check fetches the appcast from this website once a day. Sparkle sends the app’s name and version in the User-Agent and no system profile.
faq_data_text: Nothing else leaves your Mac: no analytics, no crash reporting. Your windows, shortcuts and config file stay local. See the Privacy Policy.
faq_macs: How many Macs can I use?
faq_move: How do I move my license to another Mac?
faq_move_text: On the Mac you want to free, open Settings, go to General and choose Deactivate This Mac. Then activate your license on the other Mac.
faq_refund_text: You can ask for a refund within 30 days of purchase, no questions asked. Email support@damao.io with your order number. See the Refund Policy.
thanks_key_email: It is also in the email from Dodo Payments. If you can’t find that email, check your spam folder.
thanks_no_key: Your license key is in the email from Dodo Payments. If you can’t find it, check your spam folder.
thanks_step_1: Open Piccolo. If you don’t have it yet, download it first.
thanks_step_2: Click the Piccolo icon in the menu bar and choose Enter License Key…
thanks_fine: One license covers 3 Macs. Questions? Write to support@damao.io.
